components.name: AnimatePresence
components.summary:
Keeps one native child alive while its exit targets are animated by the Rust renderer.
Keep the boundary itself mounted and toggle `present` so Tarve can retain native identity.

props.name: exit
props.doc: Numeric targets held until their native transitions finish.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable identity for this presence boundary.

props.name: enter
props.doc: Initial numeric values applied when the native node is first mounted.

props.name: transition
props.doc: Overrides the child's style.transition for enter/exit motion.

props.name: language
props.doc: Syntect syntax name, token, or file extension.

props.name: path
props.doc: Optional path used for extension-based language detection.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.doc: Paint line numbers as non-selectable chrome.

props.name: syntaxTheme
props.doc: Overrides syntax colours without changing parsing or layout.

components.name: DataGrid
components.summary: Virtualized controlled data grid with local/manual sort, filtering and row selection.

props.name: collapsedPaths
props.doc: File paths rendered as headers only.

props.name: maxLines
props.doc: Maximum changed/context lines to render per file before a Show more row.

props.name: oldText
props.doc: Supply both oldText and newText to calculate a diff natively.

props.name: onLineClick
props.type: (event: { text: string; path?: string; oldLine?: number; newLine?: number }) => void

props.name: source
props.doc: A unified or git diff.

props.name: syntaxTheme
props.doc: Overrides syntax colours without changing parsing or layout.

props.name: wordDiff
props.doc: Enables/disables word-level emphasis inside paired changed lines. Default: true.

components.name: Direction
components.summary: Layout direction helper. RTL reverses visual horizontal flow while preserving logical/focus order. Text bidi is not changed.

props.name: src
props.doc: Local path, data URL, encoded bytes, or raw RGBA8 pixels.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Enter (with or without modifiers) submits the current value.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Native hyperlink primitive. Opens `href` through the platform's registered URI handler.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label override for icon-only or otherwise non-textual links.

components.name: List
components.summary: A regular, non-virtual list. Every item stays mounted and can have any height.

props.name: onLinkClick
props.doc: Overrides the default platform URI action for a clicked Markdown link.

props.name: syntaxTheme
props.doc: Overrides syntax colours without changing parsing or layout.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A loading indicator: an arc that turns once every 800 ms, rotated natively by `style.spin`.

props.name: submitOnEnter
props.doc: When true, Enter submits and Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter always submits.

components.name: Toaster
components.summary: Render-driven toaster: callers own the toast array and remove items in onDismiss.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: Controlled desktop tree with roving keyboard focus and explicit expansion/selection state.

components.name: VirtualList
components.summary: Fixed-height rows; the caller keeps `offset` and updates it from `onScroll`.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable list id is required so measured heights survive rerenders.

props.name: itemCount
props.doc: Total logical row count; `items` contains only the mounted window.

props.name: windowStart
props.doc: Logical index represented by `items[0]`.

commonProps.name: motionFrom
commonProps.doc: Initial numeric values for a native enter transition.

commonProps.name: onPaste
commonProps.doc: Receives non-text clipboard content (files or a bitmap) pasted while focused.

types.AccordionItem: interface AccordionItem { value: string; title: string; content: Child; disabled?: boolean }
types.ImageSource: type ImageSource = string | Uint8Array | ImageBytesSource | ImageRgbaSource;
types.RadioOption: interface RadioOption { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }
types.ScrollPosition: interface ScrollPosition { x: number; y: number; maxX: number; maxY: number }
types.SelectOption: interface SelectOption { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }
types.TabItem: interface TabItem { value: string; label: string; content: Child; disabled?: boolean }
types.WindowPosition: type WindowPosition = WindowPositionPreset | { x: number; y: number };
